title: Add AN-2 PIN-guard regression tests for switch-account, add-profile, and switch-to-adult-profile

evidence.quote: /// (edit, delete, add profile, switch account, switch to adult profile) behind
/// AN-2: Escalating actions (switch to adult profile, edit, delete, switch
// The sheet renders without crashing even with pinGuardRequired=true.

why: Both the widget's own class doc and this test file's header promise PIN-guard coverage for 5 escalating actions, but the test bodies only tap the per-row edit and delete IconButtons (plus one no-guard control case). Nothing taps the 'Switch account' ListTile, the 'Add Profile' ListTile, or a non-active profile row while pinGuardRequired=true. test/e2e/journeys/profiles_p1_test.dart (E2E-718, outside this batch) independently confirms the gap: its own comment says 'Full PIN challenge drive requires device integration test' and only asserts the sheet renders without crashing, never that tapping Add Profile actually raises the PIN dialog. A future refactor of _guardEscalating's call sites for these 3 actions could silently let a child-context user reach account switching or profile creation with no test catching it.
recommendation: Add 3 testWidgets to an2_switcher_pin_guard_test.dart mirroring the existing edit/delete cases: tap 'Switch account', tap 'Add Profile', and tap a non-active adult profile row, each with pinGuardRequired=true, asserting find.text('Enter Parent PIN') appears.
acceptance_criteria: an2_switcher_pin_guard_test.dart has passing tests for switch-account, add-profile, and switch-to-adult-profile with pinGuardRequired=true
Each new test fails (red) if its corresponding _guardEscalating wrapper is removed from profile_switcher_sheet.dart
The file's header outline accurately lists every covered action
